blurb: Bear Creek Golf Club is a private member-only golf club with a Jack Nicklaus signature design, located in the foothills below the Santa Rosa Plateau in Murrieta, CA. The club offers golf, clubhouse dining, special events, weddings, and tournaments. The facility includes a renovated clubhouse, patio, outdoor bridal ceremony area, and scenic views of the golf course and surrounding landscape.
